description:
Make every validation capture request the event log through the end-of-log probe, so `jit validate` and broad built-in prechecks never read the whole log.

## Background

Repository validation no longer parses the event log. The non-mutation validation base still captures the log whole (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:415-416`, `mutation=false`), and `discover_issue_closure` requests it whole for broad built-in prechecks (`commands/validate.rs:884`). Mutation bases already capture only the tail (`validate.rs:415`), asserted at `:3712-3722`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every validation capture, mutation or not, requests the event log through `discover_tail`, and `discover_issue_closure` requests no whole log; a unit test pins the read mode for both.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Validation captures read only the event log's end
